scope: Independent audit of c8 sparse rational-rate endotactic recognition complexity; no edits to c8 parent artifacts.

claims.statement: For the essential-source predicate on explicit sparse positive rational generalized-polynomial channels with dimension included in the input, NON-ENDOTACTIC is NP-complete and ENDOTACTIC is coNP-complete, provided the z>0 UNSAT converse explicitly handles neutral clauses by averaging their three literal values.
assumptions: Finite nonempty numerator and denominator supports with rational exponents and strictly positive rational coefficients.
Rational reaction vectors are explicitly encoded; direction w ranges over real vectors.
Neutral channels are removed before the maximum, and every exact active top tie is checked.
Dimension varies as part of the input.
3SAT source clauses use three distinct variables for coefficient-one hardness.
claims.novelty_boundary: The reduction and sparse quotient-support complexity statement were not found in the scoped primary search; historical priority remains unknown and no external proof review is claimed.
claims.costs: The map uses n+1 dimensions, 3n+m+1 channels, and O(n+m) listed terms; full dense coordinate serialization remains polynomial. Dimension-fixed XP algorithms are not ruled out.
claims.falsifier: A counterdirection for an UNSAT formula, a satisfiable formula whose assignment direction lacks an outward active top tie, a non-polynomial witness-bit counterexample, or a failure of exact support formulas under positive coefficient aggregation.
claims.next_gate: External proof review of the all-directions UNSAT converse and rational LP witness-bit lemma; comprehensive scoped priority search.

claims.statement: The c8 top-level PROOF.md omits a necessary z>0 subcase in its stated UNSAT argument: neutral clauses are not constrained by target being an active top. The missing implication is repaired because S_C=0 gives average literal value z, hence some literal is at least z. The child HARDNESS.md contains this repair. The satisfying-witness sentence claiming both guards score -1 is an arithmetic typo; their scores are -1 and -3.
assumptions: Clause has three literal occurrences and S_C is the sum of sigma*u_i-z over occurrences.
All nonzero active channel scores are compared exactly; neutral clauses are excluded before maximizing.
claims.novelty_boundary: This is a proof-document correction, not a refutation of the theorem: the other report supplies the omitted average argument.
claims.costs: The repair adds one line of exact arithmetic; the guard-score correction changes no inequality needed by the reduction.
claims.falsifier: An example with S_C=0 and all three literal values less than z, or a truth assignment direction with either guard score not in {-1,-3}.
claims.next_gate: Update the primary proof file with the neutral-clause average and correct guard-score sentence.

claims.statement: The 3SAT reduction does not prove coNP-hardness for standard strong endotacticity. Standard GMS strong endotacticity requires an inward reaction at the global maximum over all sources, retaining neutral sources; the all-eight-clauses UNSAT instance at (0,0,0,-1) has only neutral guards at global score 2.
assumptions: Strong endotacticity is the GMS Definition 3.14(4) all-reactant source-maximum condition.
The fixture has all eight sign patterns of one 3-variable, 3-literal clause.
claims.novelty_boundary: No lower bound for strong-endotactic recognition is claimed. The auxiliary essential-top-face label in child_hardness/HARDNESS.md is nonstandard and its added condition, as written, collapses to ordinary endotacticity.
claims.costs: The exact Fraction replay is finite and fixture-specific; it only blocks the claimed transfer and does not settle complexity of the standard strong property.
claims.falsifier: An inward reaction at global source score 2 in the listed direction, or a different source definition that expressly excludes neutral sources (which would no longer be standard GMS strong endotacticity).
claims.next_gate: If strong hardness is pursued, construct a separate reduction controlling all-source neutral maxima.

claims.statement: The reduction uses positive rational rates that can be unbounded or singular at the boundary, including Xi/Z^2 and 1/(Xi Z^2); it does not establish hardness for globally bounded rational laws, canonical Hill/Michaelis-Menten syntax, or other restricted biochemical kinetics.
assumptions: The formal input promises positivity only on the open positive orthant through positive numerator and denominator coefficients.
No boundary regularity, global boundedness, or rate/source-complex compatibility is imposed in the sparse quotient encoding.
claims.novelty_boundary: The broad class includes rational/tropical neighboring work, but the reduction has not been mapped into canonical Hill/MM or globally bounded subfamilies; their complexity is unknown here.
claims.costs: The common-denominator lift can be exponentially larger than the sparse quotient input; exact explicit mass-action diagram costs are not poly-bounded by this reduction.
claims.falsifier: An explicit polynomial-size transformation of this reduction into the named restricted kinetic syntax, or a separate proof establishing such restricted hardness.
claims.next_gate: Either prove a restricted-syntax embedding with full size accounting or design a specialized algorithm for that subclass.

claims.statement: Scoped primary sources establish finite explicit reaction-diagram endotactic/strong recognition and rational/polynomial tropical-equilibration methods, but no exact collision for sparse rational quotient-support endotactic recognition or its complexity was identified; priority remains unknown.
assumptions: The comparison is limited to the primary sources listed in PRIMARY_SOURCES.md and targeted searches recorded there.
claims.novelty_boundary: No exhaustive search or first-of-kind claim is made.
claims.costs: JPD's explicit graph input can be exponentially larger after denominator expansion; Samal et al.'s tropical equilibration endpoint differs from universal endotactic recognition.
claims.falsifier: A primary source defining the same sparse quotient input and proving or algorithmically resolving the same universal active-source predicate.
claims.next_gate: Search citations and computational-complexity literature around endotactic recognition, succinctly encoded reaction networks, and tropical support-order predicates.
